questions.q: Before splicing, what must you do to the fibre ends?
Where does a customer's fibre drop usually land?
a: The distribution point (CBT) on the pole

questions.q: An ONT with no light usually means…
a: A break or bad splice back to the cabinet
The customer's Wi-Fi password is wrong

questions.q: What protects a finished splice?
a: A splice protector in a tray

questions.q: The maximum length of a CAT6 run is about…
PoE lets a switch…
a: Power devices over the network cable

questions.q: Where should the router's WAN port be connected?
A crimped RJ45 must be…
a: Wired to the same standard on both ends

questions.q: An analogue (HD-TVI) camera records on…
Remote viewing needs the NVR to be…
a: Cabled to a router with internet and remote viewing on

questions.q: Which camera reads number plates?
Too many PoE cameras on one NVR causes…
Before working on a circuit you must…
a: Isolate it and prove it dead

questions.q: Solar panels feed the house through…
An EV charger needs…
a: Its own circuit from the consumer unit

questions.q: Servers shut themselves down when the hall gets too…
A rack needs what in it to be online?
In a power cut, the racks run from…
a: The UPS battery (and a generator if there is one)

questions.q: A failed drive in a server is…
A Pro tracker's backup battery keeps it…
a: Reporting when the car's power is cut

questions.q: Trackers report position over…
Where are hard-wired trackers usually fitted?
Which device terminates the fiber at the customer and gives Ethernet?
What must be checked before activating an ONT?
a: Optical power at the ONT is in range

questions.q: What happens if the wrong ONT serial is registered?
a: The OLT never authenticates it — no service

questions.q: Where does an aerial drop start?
a: At the FDT on the pole

questions.q: What is the last test before handing over?
LOS is red on the ONT. What does it mean?
a: No light is reaching the ONT

questions.q: Which tool tells you the distance to a fiber break?
Many ONTs on the same PON went down together. The fault is probably…
A slow-speed ticket is closed when…
a: A speed test reaches at least 80% of the plan

questions.q: What does a passive optical splitter do?
a: Divides the light between many customers, with no power

questions.q: Where are splitters usually located?
a: In the FDH (and sometimes FDTs or closures)

questions.q: What carries aerial fiber between poles?
a: A messenger strand it is lashed to

questions.q: Why record every splice in inventory and GIS?
a: So the NOC can trace a customer to the OLT and find faults

questions.q: Order for fusion splicing:
Which tool tells you how far away a break is?
After re-splicing, what proves the repair?
a: OTDR and power-meter tests on each fiber

questions.q: Why splice fibers in order?
a: So each customer stays on the right PON

questions.q: What does the OLT do?
a: Lights the PON and authenticates ONTs

questions.q: What is an ODF for?
a: Terminating and patching fiber to equipment

questions.q: Which protocol exchanges routes with other networks at the internet edge?
What does a BNG handle?
a: Subscriber sessions, IP assignment and policies

questions.q: Why are aggregation links redundant?
a: So one failure doesn’t take an area down

questions.q: Many ONTs on one PON drop together. Likely cause?
a: A shared fault: cut, splitter, OLT port or power

questions.q: What helps find where a fault is on the ground?
Which piece of kit lets a store take card and phone payments?
How close must the kit be to the terminal to join the till?
a: Within a few metres, on the same counter

questions.q: Where does a card payment's money go?
a: The business account, less the processing fee

questions.q: Which way should the customer display face?

companyRoles._about: Which company does each job in the city. Change a value to give that role to another company (by its code) — e.g. make your own ISP the "isp" company.

market._about: Sub-companies, wholesale and leasing. Players (or you) run sub-companies under the main company (companyRoles.main); they lease fibre lines, mobile network access, masts and other kit from the provider companies and sell their own packages, plans and products in their own store. Wholesale prices start here and are then edited per provider on OPS Hub → Market.
